{{6SEBracket2on2}} == Use == Format usually used in tournaments with a group stage with two groups. After the Round Robin, the 2nd and 3rd ranked teams or players face one-another (cross-group), after which the winner advances to play against a 1st ranked team or player. The winners of those meet in the Grand Finals *R1 starts with 4 seeds (R1D1-4) who play. *R2W1 and R2W2 are the advancing players, they are now up against the higher seeds who drop down into the bracket (R2D1 and R2D2). *The winners play each other in the finals (R3W1 vs R3W2) * If a map went to overtime, use |mapXot=. The value equals the number of consecutive OT's on this map. * Walkover: set race to wo, i.e |R1D3race=wo. Can also be set to red, green, blue, yellow and white - please avoid this if you can. * 3rd place match variables are R3D1 and R3D2. If the 3rd place match is not played, nothing needs to be filled in those fields and the 3rd place match will not appear on the page. *Display declaration of players for each team with |RxDxlineup=. No linked text. Separate with '&' or ',': |R1D1lineup=Player1 & player2''' *To '''customize the names of the Rounds''' (default: Quarterfinals, Semifinals, Finals) use: |R1= |R2= |L2= *To '''remove Round titles''' completely use: |hideroundtitles=true *To customize '''column width''' or '''score width''' use: |column-width= |score-width= *To add information about maps, link to vods, a short note, etc. use (See [[Template:BracketMatchSummary]] for further details): == Copy/Paste ==
